name: NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF)
description: A voluntary framework with five functions (Identify, Protect, Detect, Respond, Recover) and associated categories/subcategories for managing cybersecurity risk. Free self-assessment tools available.
reputation: De facto U.S. cybersecurity standard; adopted globally; 50%+ of U.S. organizations use it.
notes: Self-assessment susceptible to overrating; CSF 2.0 added governance function in 2024.
